The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's initial plan. It assigned FileSurfer to "manually listen to the audio recording" and extract the page numbers, but FileSurfer has no audio-listening capability. Its only tool output was the transcription error. That false capability assumption was never corrected and drove the repeated "please listen/play the file" requests in steps 3–19, which exhausted the replan budget. Once the team lacked any working way to access the audio, the run could not reach the correct answer (132, 133, 134, 197, 245). The fabricated final answer at step 122 is a downstream symptom of that stalled run.
